general.title: Product sets
general.description: Set configurator: sets with slots, options and price formulas

detail.saveError: The set could not be saved.
detail.name: Name
detail.setFormulaHelp: Optional. Variables: base (main product price), options (sum of options). Without a formula, base + options applies. Example: (base + options) * 0.9 for 10 % off.
detail.product: Product (variants: parent = customer chooses, variant = fixed preselection)
detail.nestedSetHelp: If this option is chosen, the customer also configures this set. Its total is added to the option price.
detail.optionFormulaHelp: Unit price of the option. Variables: price, quantity, base, nested, option.<name>, product.<name>, field.<name>. Without a formula: product price (static option: 0).
detail.customValuesHelp: One line per value: name=number. Usable in formulas as option.name.
detail.fieldNameHelp: Letters, digits and _ only. Usable in formulas as field.name.
detail.choicesHelp: One line per value: value|label|number. The number is used in price formulas as value or field.name.
detail.fieldFormulaHelp: Surcharge per unit. In addition to the option variables there is value (checkbox 1/0, number, choice number, text 1 if filled).
detail.assignmentsHelp: A product can only have one set. A set on a parent product also applies to all variants; an own assignment on a variant takes precedence.
detail.saveFirst: Please save the set first, then you can assign products.
detail.targetsHelp: All products of a category (optionally including subcategories) or of a manufacturer receive this set. Precedence: assignment directly on the product, then category (most specific first), then manufacturer. On a tie the earlier created set wins.

transfer.invalidFile: The file could not be read. Please choose a set export file (JSON).
transfer.problems: This file cannot be imported as is:
transfer.summary: Checked: {created} new sets, {replaced} will be replaced, {reassigned} products will be moved to another set.
transfer.replaceWarning: Existing sets with the same name are replaced completely (slots, options, fields, assignments).
